_source_rule: Tum degerler mevcut KB/senaryo kayitlarindan birebir tasindi (diagnostic_copilot.py:2605 yag basinci, senaryo 7 hararet >108C, senaryo 6 turbo >2.5 bar). Yeni degerler yalniz operator onayiyla eklenir — agent deger uydurmaz (AGENTS.md 2.3).

EngineCoolantTemp.source_ref: diagnostic_copilot.py senaryo 7 (P0115/SPN 110): coolant_temp > 108.0 -> CRITICAL_STOP esigi; nominal alt sinir J1939-71 ET1 ofset -40C

TurboBoost.source_ref: diagnostic_copilot.py senaryo 6 (P0234/P0299/SPN 102): boost_bar > 2.5 -> overboost senaryosu esigi

EngineOilPressure.source_ref: diagnostic_copilot.py:2605 SPN 100 senaryo adimi: 'Rolantide min 1.0 bar, 2000 RPM'de 3.0 bar' — coklu rpm-band temsili
